title: Molecular dynamics simulations reveal DNA gate opening mechanisms for M. smegmatis topoisomerase 1A
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD和伞形采样模拟分枝杆菌拓扑异构酶1A的DNA门控开放机制，属广义蛋白-DNA互作动态机理研究，方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系，但对象非TF-DNA。
abstract:
ABSTRACT

Type 1A topoisomerases relax torsional strain in DNA via a strand passage mechanism in which a protein mediated DNA gate must open during the enzyme’s catalytic cycle. This gate-open conformational state of the enzyme has been challenging to observe via experimental methods. In this study, we first used equilibrium Molecular Dynamics simulations to probe the structural properties of the gate closed state for the DNA-free apo system and a system with a ssDNA bound at the DNA binding site. For both systems, we followed the equilibrium simulations with Umbrella Sampling simulations. Umbrella sampling allowed us to bias the protein to adopt a gate-open state to study the properties of this conformation, as well as the pathways leading to it. We observed that several electrostatic interactions contribute to the closed-state stability of the protein which were broken during the gate opening. The gate opening comprised of three major domain motions that were determined from simulation trajectories and Principal Component Analysis. Finally, umbrella sampling results combined with the Weighted Histogram Analysis Method allowed us to reconstruct the free energy profiles of gate opening for all simulations.

SIGNIFICANCE

Multi-drug resistant bacterial strains necessitate newer ways of targeting bacteria. Type 1A topoisomerases are potential anti-bacterial drug targets. Current strategies are to either block the protein binding to DNA or prevent the cut DNA being religated during the catalytic cycle. A possible alternative to these methods would be to trap the protein at an open conformation. Structural information about the transient open state is crucial to this approach. Results of this study provide mechanistic details of gate opening. This information furthers the understanding of the topoisomerase catalytic cycle which will aid in anti-topoisomerase drug design efforts.
abstract_zh:
摘要

1A型拓扑异构酶通过链穿越机制松弛DNA中的扭转应力，在该机制中，蛋白质介导的DNA门必须在酶的催化循环过程中打开。通过实验方法观察该酶的开门构象状态一直具有挑战性。在本研究中，我们首先使用平衡分子动力学 (equilibrium Molecular Dynamics) 模拟来探究无DNA的apo系统以及单链DNA结合在DNA结合位点上的系统的关门状态的结构特性。对于这两个系统，我们在平衡模拟之后进行了伞形采样 (Umbrella Sampling) 模拟。伞形采样使我们能够对蛋白质施加偏置以使其采用开门状态，从而研究该构象的特性以及通向该构象的路径。我们观察到，若干静电相互作用有助于蛋白质的关门状态稳定性，而这些相互作用在开门过程中被破坏。开门过程包含三个主要结构域运动，这些运动通过模拟轨迹和主成分分析 (Principal Component Analysis) 确定。最后，伞形采样结果结合加权直方图分析法 (Weighted Histogram Analysis Method) 使我们能够重建所有模拟中开门的自由能图谱。

意义

多重耐药菌株需要新的靶向细菌方法。1A型拓扑异构酶是潜在的抗菌药物靶点。当前策略要么是阻断蛋白质与DNA结合，要么是防止催化循环过程中切割后的DNA被重新连接。这些方法的一个可能替代方案是将蛋白质捕获在开放构象状态。关于瞬时开放状态的结构信息对此方法至关重要。本研究结果提供了开门的机制细节。这些信息加深了对拓扑异构酶催化循环的理解，这将有助于抗拓扑异构酶药物设计工作。
